backup.title: Export & import

backup.autoHint: Once a day the whole company — all projects — is archived into your bucket. Seven copies are kept, older ones are removed.
backup.separateStorageHint: Its own account and keys, not just another bucket. A copy sitting in the same account is unavailable exactly when you need it — if that account is locked or compromised.
backup.testHint: We write and delete a test file before saving, so a wrong key is caught here and not by the nightly backup.
